questions.q: Which actress plays Carol Danvers in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: Brie Larson plays Carol Danvers in Captain Marvel (2019) and later films.

questions.q: Before gaining powers, Carol Danvers worked for which military branch in the comics?
questions.why: Carol debuted in 1968 as an Air Force officer and security chief at a restricted military base.

questions.q: Which 2023 MCU film is a sequel to Captain Marvel (2019)?
questions.why: The Marvels (2023) continued the story of the 2019 Captain Marvel film.

questions.q: A Psyche-Magnetron explosion fused Carol's genes with those of which Kree hero?
questions.why: The blast mixed her DNA with the Kree hero Mar-Vell, making her a human-Kree hybrid.

questions.q: Who wrote the 2012 series in which Carol Danvers took up the Captain Marvel name?
questions.why: DeConnick scripted that July 2012 launch, with Dexter Soy on art, and Carol moved from Ms. Marvel to Captain Marvel.

questions.q: In The Avengers Annual #10 (1981), which X-Men foe absorbed Carol's powers and memories?
questions.why: Rogue permanently drained Carol's powers and memories, which Professor X later helped restore.

questions.q: Which cosmic codename did Carol take after Brood experiments linked her to a white hole?
questions.why: As Binary she wielded star-level power; the identity first appeared in Uncanny X-Men #164.
Gerry Conway wrote the debut of the Ms. Marvel series, drawn by John Buscema.

questions.q: Which duo created Carol Danvers in Marvel Super-Heroes #13 (1968)?
questions.why: Roy Thomas wrote and Gene Colan drew her as a military security officer.

questions.q: Which codename did Kurt Busiek and George Perez coin for Carol in The Avengers vol. 3 #4 (1998)?
questions.why: Busiek and Perez gave her the Warbird name when she rejoined the Avengers in 1998.
